d:
Have you ever seen a place so unreal that it looks like another planet? Welcome to Namibia, one of Africa's most extraordinary travel destinations!
In this episode of our Namibia road trip, we explore the world-famous Sossusvlei and Deadvlei (Dead Valley) in the Namib Desert, surrounded by towering red sand dunes and ancient black trees. Did you know that the Bollywood song **Guzarish from Ghajini**, starring Aamir Khan and Asin, was filmed in Namibia? The Tamil song **Nenje Nenje from Ayan**, starring Suriya and Tamannaah, also features Namibia's spectacular landscapes!
